chapter.verse: Pasian aw, nangma itna kip om bangin kei hong hehpih in la, na hehpihna lian om bangin ka thu palsatnate hong phiatkhiat sak in.
Ka khialhna panin kei hong silsiang kiuhkeuh in la, ka mawhna panin hong siangsak in!
Bang hang hiam cih leh ka thu palsatnate ka thei a, ka mawhna ka mai-ah om ngitnget hi.
Nangma tung mahmah-ah khialin, na muhna-ah a sia ka gamta khin hi, tua ahih ciangin na thugenna-ah nang na tang a, na thukhenna ah paubaan’na om lo hi.
En in, a khialsa mahin kei ka suakkhia a, ka nu in hong paai cil-a kipan a mawhsa ka hi hi.
En in, nang in nuntakna sungah thumanna na deih hi; tua ahih ciangin ka lungsim tawngah ciimna hong hilh in.
Puknah tawh hong nul in, kei ka siang ding hi; hong sil in, vuk sangin ka ngozaw ding hi.
Lungdamna leh kipahna hong pia in la, na sukgawpsa mipa lungdamsak in.
Ka mawhna na mai panin seel in la, ka khialhna khempeuh hong phiatkhiat sak in.
Pasian aw, ka sungah lungsim siangtho hong piangsak in la, a thak, a man, ngaihsutna ka sungah hong guan in.
Na omna panin kei hong paikhia kei in la, kei kiang panin na Kha Siangtho la kei in.
Na hotkhiatna hangin lungdamna kei hong ngahsak kik in la, utna lungsim tawh kei hong huh in.
Tua ciangin thu palsatte na zia ka hilh ding a, mimawhte nangma lamah hong kihei kik ding uh hi.
Pasian, kei hong hon Pasian aw, sih nading daan panin kei hong honkhia in; nong hotkhiatna thu lungdam takin ka sa ding hi.
Topa aw, ka pau theih nadingin hong huh in; nangmah ka hong phat ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh ganhing tawh biakna na deih kei hi, meihal biakna nang hong pia hi ta-leng zong, nang na lungdam kei ding hi.
Pasian’ san’ theih biakna in lungsim kitamzan hi; Pasian aw, a kitamzan, a kisik lungsim na simmawh kei ding hi.
Na lungkimna pha tawh Zion tungah a pha bawl in; Jerusalem kulhpite ciang kik in,
tua ciangin, biakpiakna man, meihal biakna leh meihal biakpiakna bup-ah na lungkim ding hi; tua ciangin na biakna tau tungah bawngtalte hong kipia ding hi.
